rationale: Enhance the original features by incorporating additional customer and product characteristics to improve the prediction model's performance.

aggregates.name: f_recent_transactions_count
aggregates.sql: COUNT(CASE WHEN days_ago BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)

derived.name: f_high_transaction_rate
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_recent_transactions_ratio > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_diversified_purchases
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_unique_products > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_expensive_customers
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_avg_price > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
